reason: Per 04-live-semantic-judge-run.json, no authorized model credential is available, and the phase charter's Section 12 mandates live semantic judgment as the FIRST step of the rerun sequence, before deterministic V2 aggregation and before independent second-pass adjudication. No second-pass rerun was performed in Phase 3F.1.5.1. The 05-second-pass-protocol.json and 06-frozen-sample.json artifacts describe what this step WOULD execute once unblocked; this artifact intentionally contains no results, per the phase charter's explicit instruction not to substitute mocks for the live-model requirement and not to claim the phase passed without one.
whatRemainsTrueAndUnchanged: The original Phase 3F.1.5 second-pass results (docs/evaluation-v2/08-second-pass-adjudication.json, 51 cases, binary agreement 78.4%/84.3%, detailed agreement 37.3%) remain the only actual second-pass adjudication evidence that exists. Nothing in Phase 3F.1.5.1 supersedes, replaces, or invalidates that record - it is preserved byte-for-byte (00-freeze-manifest.json) and remains the basis for 01-original-disagreement-forensics.json's classification.
whatThisPhaseAddedInstead: A full forensic explanation of WHY that original result came in below threshold (01-original-disagreement-forensics.json), showing that the great majority of the shortfall (65.6% of detailed disagreements) is a taxonomy-vocabulary artifact rather than a genuine credit-direction disagreement, that the largest genuine disagreement cluster is traceable to a disclosed, deliberate design choice which is independently validated as CORRECT by at least one case (doc-a::VI::6.10-chapeau reproducing a confirmed historical false credit), and that a smaller, separate, newly-discovered V2_LOGIC_DEFECT (the over-broad 'Acquisition' definition match) also contributes. None of this changes the numeric gate outcome, which remains a miss - only a live rerun with a real credential can determine whether the taxonomy/protocol fix and the live semantic judge together would close the gap.
